title: What Happened While I Was Asleep
paragraphs: Just as I was lost in these deep thoughts, Father said with a worried look on his face:
“…If world peace were to come, would Motoyasu-kun end up looping back to somewhere else again?”
“Unfortunately, I’m not quite sure about that.”
After all, if I were to enjoy those peaceful days to the fullest, I’d end up looping back before I even realized it.
“I wonder why Motoyasu-kun is looping again.”
“That’s a mystery even to me.”

Come to think of it, I don’t feel like I’ll ever solve the mystery of why I’m looping. However, Big Sister mentioned before that I’m looping because of my desire to see Filo-tan. There must be some reason for it, but I’ll just stay true to my love.
“Father in this world gave me all sorts of advice the last time I looped, didn’t he?”
“That brings back memories… I think I hurriedly asked him for all sorts of things because I knew I’d end up looping again.”

His advice was that it would be best to follow the path of the first world. …Come to think of it, Father’s advice in this world was spot-on. After all, I wanted to see Filo-tan. If I’d understood what Father said more clearly, I wouldn’t have done anything to upset Big Sister, and I would’ve been able to reunite with Filo-tan.
“…Maybe Motoyasu-kun will end up looping back to some other world again. I suppose you’ll come to my aid in that parallel world when I’m in trouble, won’t you?”
“Of course. For this Motoyasu, helping Father is my mission, after all.”
It’s a promise I made to Filo-tan. We must bring true peace to the world, after all.
“Haha, the next version of me in trouble… It makes me feel a little lonely, somehow.”
“There’s no need to feel lonely. I’m always right here with you, Father.”
“I see… I guess so.”
Saying that, Father leaned back on the terrace with a slightly wistful look as he gazed out at the townscape.
“Naofumi! I’m home!”
Rival landed in the garden in dragon form, flying in from above Siltvelt. Just when the mood was setting in, here comes an interruption.
“Welcome back, Gaelion. You were going to see Wyndia, weren’t you?”
“That’s right. While I was there, I dropped off my little brother for Big Sister.”

The “little brother” Rival is referring to is a dragon from the first world who shares the same name as him. Apparently, Rival tracked him down by visiting the market and various other places. The story goes that she took this male rival—her own younger brother—to her parents’ house to be looked after by her family’s Assistant.
“This should really cheer up Big Sister.”
“Well… I’m not so sure about that. Anyway, how was Wyndia?”
“It seemed like she’d made up with Dad. Also, once the world becomes much more peaceful, Gaelion will officially become her guardian, and she’ll come here to learn about society.”
“That’s great to hear.”
“It is~. Well then, Naofumi, it’s almost time for the meeting. Let’s get ready to leave.”
“I know.”
“I’ll be waiting, then~”
With that, Rival took human form in the garden and walked into the castle. She sure is a rowdy one.
“I wasn’t sure what would happen with Shieldfreeden when I first went to inspect it… but really, thanks to Gaelion-chan’s hard work, we’ve been saved in so many ways.”
“…I take issue with that, but you’re right.”

Shieldfreeden is now well on its way to recovery, with that guy leading the charge. I heard the other day that even the nobles who had believed in Takt’s restoration have now raised the white flag and donated their accumulated wealth. Since the events are organized by him, the shows performed by Filolial-sama are also very well-received. This is a fact, I assure you.
“It’s amazing, isn’t it, Gaelion-chan… I don’t think I could ever have done that.”
“You’re overestimating me.”
He’s a dragon, after all.
“…Gaelion-chan, you can travel through various worlds with Motoyasu-kun, right?”
“That’s right. He’s a parasite that lives off my spear.”

Just thinking about it makes me sick. Why must I have to loop with a creature like that? In this next loop, I must do my best to stay as far away from the dragon’s egg as possible. I must prove that he’s unnecessary.
“Now, now… Motoyasu, I think you’d feel better if you accepted Gaelion-chan just a little. After all… she’s a companion you’re looping with, isn’t she?”
“If I’m going to loop with someone, I’d rather it be Filo-tan.”
Why do I have to keep looping with that creature over and over again?! She’s a sexual-harassment dragon who’s constantly after Father. It’s about time she just disappeared!
“Hmm…”
Father is giving a wry smile at my response.
“I actually think Gaelion-chan’s a nice person, though…”
“Father, don’t let him fool you. He’s definitely up to something.”
It’s important to stay on guard. Well, in this world, Father has already lost his virginity—which is what that guy is after—so there’s no need to be that cautious.
“Oops, I’d better get going soon. I’ll get to talk to Gaelion-chan today, and I’ll see if I can get along a little better with Motoyasu-kun.”
“Like oil and water—even you, Father, must know that’s impossible.”
“Ahaha… Just wait and see. Motoyasu-kun was taking care of the Filolials that Takt raised again today, wasn’t he?”
“That’s right. I hope his emotional wounds heal soon…”
“I think that side of Motoyasu is admirable. Well, I’m off then.”

And so, Father led the pandas and set off with Rival to attend meetings with Melromarc and the leaders of various nations. Apparently, there were matters to be dealt with regarding the Trash’s misdeeds.

It seems the Wise King of Wisdom was present at that meeting because Takt had been forced to take the queen and her Finacée hostage and threatened him into being there to defeat us. Of course, the Siltvelt side is well aware that this is a lie, but thanks to Father and Rival’s intercession, it seems they decided to let it slide. That said, it seems the Siltvelt side decided to back down for reasons such as the fact that even if they pressed the issue, it would be difficult to pursue it if the kidnapped queen herself testified to the contrary.
To the public, it appears the Wise King of Wisdom had his family held hostage and secretly cooperated with us to defeat Takt. It’s a messy political game.
Well, let’s make sure that Trash gets his comeuppance eventually. Heh heh heh… After all, I have that tool—one I might use someday…
With such thoughts in mind, I went to sleep.
As I lay in bed and my consciousness began to fade… I heard someone’s voice in my dreams.
“Spear Hero, Spear Hero… Can you hear my voice?”

Who could it be? I feel like I’ve heard that voice before. A woman’s voice… There are only a few women who can tell that I’m not a pig or Filolial-sama. But it’s not Éclair’s voice, nor is it Big Sister’s. Who on earth could it be?
“It’s me. I’m Atla.”
Oh, so it’s the Tiger Girl. But why would the Tiger Girl appear in my dreams?
“I’ve come this time because I have a favor to ask.”

I see. A favor, you say? In the first world, the Tiger Girl owes a debt of gratitude to the Phoenix for risking her life to protect Father and Filolial-sama. If there’s anything I can do, I’ll make it happen.
“Well then, I’d like you to make sure that when we loop again, I’ll take Raphtalia’s place.”
Hmm. Well, I suppose it’s not impossible… but I have a feeling Big Sister from the first world might get mad at me again.
“It’s okay. You don’t need to worry about Raphtalia at all.”

Hmm… You’re right! It’s true Big Sister can be strict at times, but she’s actually a very kind person. I’m sure she’ll forgive us even if Father and the tiger girl end up together and are all lovey-dovey.
Understood. If the opportunity arises, I’ll make sure the tiger girl and Father become a couple.
“In that case, I’ll leave it to you.”
After I heard that voice, everything fell silent. I slept soundly.
――However, it wasn’t until the very next day that I learned an unbelievable incident had occurred…
The next day, still groggy from a strange dream, I met up with Father and the others. Then…

"Ah, I'm just telling it like it happened! Gaelion was planning to win Naofumi over, but before he knew it, he was the one who'd been won over. I, I know you probably don't understand what I'm saying, but even Gaelion doesn't know how this happened... I feel like I'm going crazy!"

Rival is muttering that under his breath at the breakfast table in Siltvelt, looking completely dazed. Sitting next to him, Father looks troubled, as if trying to calm him down. Panda, Éclair, and Zou are also looking at my dazed rival with puzzled expressions. What on earth is going on?
“Ah, Spear Hero!”
Rival noticed I was nearby, looked up, and rushed over with a look of panic I’d never seen on his face before.
“What is it?”

“I’ll tell you exactly what happened! Gaelion was planning to win Naofumi over, but before he knew it, he’d been the one won over. I, I know you probably don’t understand what I’m saying, but even Gaelion doesn’t know how this happened… I feel like I’m going to lose my mind!”

Rival repeated the same thing as before. He’s saying something that doesn’t make much sense. It’s only natural that Father has already been “conquered.” After all, Panda has already taken Father’s virginity.
“Ugh… Gaelion’s been saying nothing but that for a while now.”
Sakura-chan, looking troubled, explains the situation to me.
“Gaelion-chan, just like with that ‘trophy wife’ thing, where did you even learn lines like that?”
“The Bow Hero from the First World said it as a joke!”
“Itsuki… he really was a funny guy. If he were still alive, I’d love to talk to him.”
Father says this with a distant look in his eyes.
“What on earth is going on? I haven’t the faintest idea.”
Yuki-chan, who came with us, and Kou, who’s with Zou, are both tilting their heads in confusion. Rival doesn’t look entirely unlike she’s on the verge of a hysterical fit.

This is that, isn’t it? As far as I can remember… it’s similar to Rival’s reaction after she figured out that Big Sister and Father had spent a fun night together. She’s probably just in shock because something truly shocking happened involving Father.
“If she’s about to lose her mind, wouldn’t it be better if she just died?”
“I think Motoyasu-kun should go along with Gaelion-chan’s story a little more…”

“No, I’m telling it exactly as it happened! Gaelion was trying to win Naofumi over, but before she knew it, she’d been the one won over. I know you probably don’t understand what I’m saying, but even Gaelion doesn’t know how this happened… I feel like I’m going to lose my mind!”
“So calm down, will you!”
“I can’t possibly stay calm! Gaelion doesn’t really understand why this is happening either!?”
“Even though Gaelion-chan wanted this herself…”
At Father’s remark, Rival’s face turned bright red, and she shook her head. Eventually, coming to her senses, she said to me:
“Spear Hero, Gaelion and the others might have been terribly mistaken! I’m absolutely certain of this! It’s the truth!”
“So what’s your point?! You’re being way too familiar—it’s creepy, so back off!”
I shoved Rival away as he closed in on me and turned my face toward Father. Father looks utterly exasperated.
“Hold on a second. Rival—I mean, you—what exactly did you do!?”

“I’ll tell you exactly what happened! Gaelion was trying to win Naofumi over, but before he knew it, he’d been the one won over. I-I know you probably don’t understand what I’m saying, but even Gaelion doesn’t know how this happened… I feel like I’m going crazy!”
“That’s exactly what I asked! Give me a proper answer!”
“Sooo—! For some reason, Gaelion was sleeping with Naofumi!”
“Why, you ask…? Did you hate it that much?”
At Father’s words, Rival instinctively gave a thumbs-up in response.
“I don’t hate it! I’m happy my long-cherished wish came true! But that’s a separate issue—I’m just constantly surprised by the gap between my imagination and reality!”
“This sounds like a complicated problem.”
“Aren’t you just making it complicated on your own?”
“Could you at least explain it step by step? Well… just as much as you’re comfortable sharing. It sounds like it might be a sexual topic, though.”
Rival nodded at Éclair’s words.

“Last night, Gaelion… Naofumi and I were having a drink and talking about all sorts of things. At one point, Gaelion got a little tipsy, and I thought I saw a vision where his dreams and reality got all mixed up. But when I woke up this morning, everything was exactly the same as in the dream, and I just can’t wrap my head around it.”
……? What on earth is this guy talking about? Does that mean… that’s exactly what happened!?
“What’s the matter? Are you just complaining that things turned out exactly as expected after that? Don’t give me a shock like that.”
“Pandaaaaaaa! Hold on a second! Did you actually witness Rival and Father sleeping together!?”
Your job is to protect Father from Rival, so why on earth did you just let that happen!? Since Sakura-chan visits her Finacée often, you have to keep a tight watch on her!
“Well, even if you say that… since the Shield Hero is on board with it, I’m not going to get in the way.”
“To begin with… Gaelion insisted she wasn’t drunk… and since she invited me over in such a romantic mood, I just went along with it and ended up sleeping with her…”

“Gaelion, whenever you do this kind of thing with Naofumi, I thought you assumed Naofumi—who can’t say no—would reluctantly go along with it, almost as if he were being half-forced by you. I’m giving back my title as the ‘Predator of Love.’ I ended up being the one who got preyed upon.”
Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!? Father’s been cuckolded! He’s been cuckolded! It’s an NTR!
“Gaelion-chan, your self-esteem is ridiculously low… Just how long have I been neglecting you, to the point where things have gotten this messed up?”
“Why on earth are you, Father, trying to win over Rival!?”
You were supposed to be fending off Rival’s fierce attacks—charging head-on at Rival with everything you’ve got is completely missing the point!
“No, I just realized I like Gaelion-chan because she’s reliable and works so hard for me, and she said she’s okay with it too… or rather, a ‘Predator of Love’…”
“No… well, this is Gaelion’s own problem. It’s just that the unattainable beauty came down from her pedestal of her own accord, leaving me a bit taken aback—so Naofumi isn’t at fault at all.”
Why is Rival fidgeting and acting all shy around Father like that!?
H-haha… It’s all right. Father was just playing around with Rival. I suppose it’s meant as a small reward for Rival, who at least tried his best. Still, I think he went a bit too far.

“Rival, you’d better admit right now that Father isn’t a virgin anymore. He’s already ‘graduated’ with a panda… Having done it once is like getting bitten by a mosquito. Don’t take it seriously. And I won’t allow you to go after virgins.”
“Wait, what the hell are you talking about!?”
“I don’t know what you’re getting the wrong idea about, but I’d appreciate it if you didn’t act like you did this on your own.”
What!? Seriously!?
“Panda! Don’t tell me… you haven’t taken Father’s virginity yet!?”
“Could you please stop going on and on about ‘virginity’!?”
“That’s exactly why! Even Gaelion is surprised! Figure it out!”
W-What the hell!?
“Could it be that Father… actually gave his virginity to a Rival!?”
“Eh… uh… yeah. Gaelion-chan is really charming and dependable, you know. I thought she’d be a good choice for my first time… and she said she wanted to sleep with me too…”

“There’s no doubt that was my true feeling, so Naofumi, you don’t need to worry about it!　Rather, I was just planning to make my move on Naofumi—once the world, which was on the brink of collapse because things had gotten hopelessly tangled and I was making a move on him, had finally returned to peace—since he’d be in a position where he couldn’t possibly refuse.”
“Even if you’re spilling the beans about your true feelings now… does that mean I’d have just pinned him down before he even had a chance to say no?”

Rival adds this, but that’s not the issue at all! I feel as if the ground beneath my feet is crumbling away. Father… you wouldn’t actually let Rival take her virginity, would you…? What on earth is going on here!?

“Let me tell you the conclusion that Gaelion, the Spear Hero, reached today. If Naofumi is like this, then Filo must be the same. Naofumi and the others—they’re the ‘top’ even though they look like the ‘bottom’!”
Rival is passionately explaining something to me, who just can’t accept this reality.
